record.question: Which Russian made jet fighter of IAF was recently shot down in a recent clash with Pakistan?
record.explanation: Answer B: MiG-21. The Indian government’s 27 February 2019 account reports the loss of one Mi G-21 in the aerial engagement. The listed aircraft is Mi G-21; Mirage-2000 is French rather than Russian. Historical/source note: Refers to the 27 February 2019 loss; the identity answer does not endorse unrelated claims about losses on the other side. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=188990. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
